# Bookswappin’ BCN

> A free book-swap community in Barcelona. Members add books they’ve finished to a shared online shelf and swap, lend or give them away, arranging meetups through a WhatsApp group. No ads, nothing to pay.

- Swap: give a book and get one back. Lend: get it back once it’s read. Give away: theirs to keep.
- Books in English, Spanish, Catalan and other languages, across Barcelona and nearby towns.
- Run by members of the group, for the group.

## Pages

- [About](https://bookswappin.com/about/): what it is and how it works
- [FAQ](https://bookswappin.com/faq/): common questions, in English
- [En español](https://bookswappin.com/es/): qué es y preguntas frecuentes
- [The shelf](https://bookswappin.com/): the live site with all the books
